responsibility: This file implements GCC’s relation-oracle machinery for SSA value relationships used by ranger-style analyses. It defines the semantics and combination tables for relation_kind values such as <, <=, ==, != and partial equivalences, provides transformations like negate, swap, union, intersection, and transitivity, and implements path_oracle storage and querying of equivalence classes and relational facts along a control-flow path. It also supplies iterators and debug dumping for equivalence sets. Its role is the concrete engine that records and answers SSA-to-SSA relational facts beyond simple ranges.
same_name_distinction: Implements the relational engine declared in value-relation.h: relation operation tables and helpers, path_oracle storage/query behavior, equivalence iteration support, and dumping/selftests.
